dishes.name: Falafel roll
dishes.desc: Falafel in flatbread with sauce and pickles. A Malmö street food closely tied to the city's Middle Eastern community.

dishes.name: Kanelbulle
dishes.desc: Swedish cinnamon bun, baked fresh in Malmö and Lund bakeries and eaten with fika.

dishes.name: Spettekaka
dishes.desc: Tall cake made of eggs, sugar and potato flour, baked on a rotating spit. A Skåne speciality sold in Lund and Malmö shops.

dishes.name: Inlagd sill
dishes.desc: Herring in spiced vinegar, eaten with potatoes and crispbread. A staple of the Skåne coast.

dishes.name: Ålagille
dishes.desc: Smoked eel with scrambled egg and potatoes, a late-summer tradition in Skåne served in coastal restaurants.

dishes.name: Köttbullar
dishes.desc: Swedish meatballs with lingonberry jam, cream sauce and potatoes, served in traditional restaurants in Malmö.
